map.P=5 kW、t=8 h：E=40 kWh。若其中 2 h 仅 2 kW，则 E: P=5 kW, t=8 h: E=40 kWh. If for 2 h it is only 2 kW, then E=5×6+2×2=34 kWh. Tip: with fluctuating power, piecewise accumulation is more accurate; multiplying over the whole period overestimates.
map.功率和能量单位怎么区分？: How to distinguish the units of power and energy?
map.功率 kW 是速率，能量 kWh 是功率×时间；如同车速与路程。: Power in kW is a rate, while energy in kWh is power × time; like vehicle speed and distance.
map.峰值功率能直接乘时间吗？: Can the peak power be multiplied by time directly?
map.不能。实际常在部分负荷，应按运行曲线或平均功率算，否则高估能量。: No. It is actually often at part load, so compute by the operating curve or average power, otherwise you overestimate the energy.
